title: 9 July 1960: Live: Grosvenor Ballroom, Wallasey
content:
This was another of The Silver Beetles’ regular concerts at the Grosvenor Ballroom, which took place every Saturday night in June and July 1960.

The Beatles performed at the Grosvenor Ballroom on 14 occasions between June 1960 and September 1961. The other dates were 4, 6, 11, 18 and 25 June; 2, 16, 23 and 30 July; 24 December 1960; 24 February; 10 March; and 15 September 1961.

Page last updated: 24 January 2024
